title: Thimsy ES-DE/nano/format.json
description: The major version of the card contract (LIBRARY-FORMAT.md) the library needs a reader to understand. Absent means 1. A reader that meets a higher major uses the library read-only and says so. Builds already in users' hands never read it, so it guards only new builds against newer ones (INTEROP-AUDIT.md, backward-compatibility rules). Only the draft-07 keywords devicejson.py validates are used.

version.description: Contract major. 1 is today's layout plus this contract's additive files. A bump needs the owner and the Android compatibility floor (interop Q12); maximum rises with it.
